question: The election of the next Vice-President is to be held within _____ of the expiry of the term of office of the outgoing Vice-President.
solution:
The correct answer is __**60 days**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vice-President**

 
 
• The election of the next Vice-President is to be held within **60 days** of the expiry of the term of office of the outgoing Vice-President.
 
• The **Election Commission of India**, which is a constitutional autonomous body, conducts the election.
 
• The **vice president **is elected** indirectly**, by an electoral college consisting of members (**elected as well as nominated**) of both Houses of Parliament, by the system of proportional representation using **single transferable votes** and the **voting is by secret ballot**.
 
• The election of the vice president is slightly different from the election of the president as the members of state legislatures are not part of the electoral college but the nominated members of **Rajya Sabha** are part of it.
 
• The nomination of a candidate for election to the office of the vice president must be subscribed by at least** 20 electors** as proposers and **20 electors **as **seconders**.
 
• Every candidate has to make a security deposit of **₹15,000** in the **Reserve Bank of India**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jagdeep Dhankhar ​

 
 
• **Jagdeep Dhankhar** is an Indian politician and lawyer, who is serving as the **14th and current vice president of India **since **11 August 2022**.
 
• Prior to serving in this position, he served as the **Governor of West Bengal**.
 
• The vice president of India is the deputy to the head of state of the Republic of India, i.e. the **president** of India.
 
• The office of **vice president **is the second-highest constitutional office after the president and ranks second in the order of precedence and first in the line of succession to the presidency.
 
• The vice president is also a member of the Parliament of India as the **ex officio chairman** of the Rajya Sabha.
